overview: The Council approved a $500,000 loan order for citywide sidewalk repairs and discussed a potential mandatory face mask policy for residents in public spaces. The body also addressed parking enforcement policies and 2020 Census outreach strategies during the COVID-19 pandemic.

items.title: Parking Policy Update (20-320)
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting an update from the administration on parking enforcement and the essential status of parking contractors during the pandemic.

items.title: 2020 Census Update (20-321)
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution to update the public on census response rates and coordinate outreach with federal liaisons and non-essential city staff.

items.title: Citywide Sidewalk Loan Order (20-316)
items.summary: Approved a $500,000 loan order for citywide sidewalk repairs on first reading following discussion regarding the repair backlog and bonding capacity.

items.title: DPW In-House Sidewalk Crew Study
items.summary: Approved a request for the DPW Director to conduct a cost analysis for establishing an internal sidewalk repair team to replace private contractors.

items.title: Subcommittee Reports on Zoning and Housing
items.summary: Approved reports referring the draft marijuana ordinance to a Committee of the Whole and requesting a draft ordinance for a housing stability task force.

items.title: Condolence Resolutions
items.summary: Adopted several condolence resolutions, including one for James Maturana, and held a moment of silence for victims of COVID-19.

items.title: Public Participation: Mandatory Face Masks
items.summary: Heard public testimony and discussed the possibility of mandating face masks in public spaces, though the administration cited enforcement challenges.

items.title: Records and DCR Announcements
items.summary: Approved the meeting records from April 21, 2020, and announced DCR paving operations scheduled for Fellsway West starting May 4.
